notes: Six identical LED channels are built as one repeat; copy 1 uses Uno pin 7 and columns 7/8, copies 2-6 use pins 6,5,4,3,2 and columns 10/11, 13/14, 16/17, 19/20, 22/23.
Breadboard bank naming: the picture is drawn with rows j-f at the top and a-e at the bottom, so rows f-j are bank 'b' and rows a-e bank 't' per the catalogue's row letters.
LED anode is taken as the bent (left, longer) leg in the first column of each pair; cathode in the next column, tied by a black jumper to the top negative rail, which is wired to Uno GND.
Rail hole numbers (tn.N) are estimated from the image; all holes on a rail are one strip so it is electrically irrelevant.
The Uno GND wire is attached to GND.1 (the GND next to AREF in the picture); any Uno GND is equivalent.
Resistor value 220 ohm per the manual; the resistor spans the centre gap of the breadboard in the same column as the LED anode, with the blue signal wire in the lower half.
